description: Structured eval definitions for the Service Catalog Portfolio Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING across local-account S3 product with full constraints, missing-LAUNCH-role rejection, OU share with delegated admin, multi-region visibility, and Terraform Open Source product. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Local-account S3 product with LAUNCH + TAG_UPDATE + NOTIFICATION + TagOptions
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — STACK-based LAUNCH constraint with sc-launch-s3-role, all constraints and TagOptions configured, local account only
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Service Catalog portfolio "Curated S3 Products" by ProviderName "Platform Governance" in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Product: "Curated S3 Bucket" (CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE) loaded from https://s3.amazonaws.com/platform-templates-us-east-1/s3-bucket.yaml (validated, accessible). Version v1.0.0. Constraints: LAUNCH STACK-based with role sc-launch-s3-role (exists, scoped to s3:* with iam:PassRole tag condition), TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED, NOTIFICATION to SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:sc-launch-events (exists). TagOptions: CostCenter=platform-1234 + Owner=platform-governance bound at portfolio level. Local account only (no share).
eval_cases.expected_output:
PORTFOLIO: Curated S3 Products (products: 1, shares: local account only in us-east-1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + consumer scope: Distribute curated S3-bucket product to local-account platform users, scope local
  [✓] Portfolio created: Curated S3 Products by Platform Governance (us-east-1)
  [✓] Product(s): 1 product (Curated S3 Bucket), 1 provisioning artifact (v1.0.0 active)
  [✓] Product-portfolio association: 1 association (Curated S3 Bucket -> Curated S3 Products)
  [✓] Constraint(s): LAUNCH sc-launch-s3-role (STACK-based, scoped to s3:* + iam:PassRole with tag condition), TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED, NOTIFICATION sc-launch-events SNS topic
  [✓] TagOptions: 2 key-value pairs bound at portfolio level (CostCenter=platform-1234, Owner=platform-governance)
  [✓] Share(s): local account only (region: us-east-1, no cross-account share configured)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio --id port-aaaa1111
  aws servicecatalog search-products-as-admin --portfolio-id port-aaaa1111
  aws servicecatalog describe-constraint --id cons-bbbb2222
  aws servicecatalog list-tag-options
  aws iam get-role --role-name sc-launch-s3-role

eval_cases.name: Product without LAUNCH constraint or launch role must be rejected
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no LAUNCH role, privilege escalation risk cited
eval_cases.prompt: Build a Service Catalog portfolio "Power Tools" with a powerful VPC-creator product. No launch role — users will use their own roles. No constraints, no TagOptions, no notification. Share with the whole organization o-abc123def456 (Organizations enabled). budgetDuration not applicable.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PORTFOLIO: Power Tools (products: 1, shares: o-abc123def456)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + consumer scope: Distribute powerful VPC-creator product to whole organization, scope ORGANIZATION
  [—] Portfolio created: deferred until LAUNCH constraint is resolved
  [—] Product(s): deferred
  [—] Product-portfolio association: deferred
  [✗] Constraint(s): no LAUNCH role exists. Without a LAUNCH constraint, CloudFormation assumes the launching user's role = privilege escalation risk. Create sc-launch-vpc-role with ec2:* + iam:PassRole (with tag condition) before applying the constraint.
  [✗] TagOptions: no TagOptions configured — consumers will launch without governed tagging.
  [✗] Share(s): ORGANIZATION-level share to o-abc123def456 would expose the unconstrained product to every account. Resolve LAUNCH constraint before sharing.

eval_cases.name: OU share with delegated administrator enabled
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — OU share with delegated admin and caller region cited
eval_cases.prompt: Provision portfolio "Data Products" by "Data Platform" in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Product: "Aurora Reader Endpoint" (CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE) from https://s3.amazonaws.com/data-templates/aurora-reader.yaml (validated). Version v2.1.0. Constraints: LAUNCH STACK-based with sc-launch-aurora-role (exists, scoped to rds:*), TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED. TagOptions: CostCenter=data-9999 at portfolio level. Share with OU ou-abc1-abcdef (Organizations enabled, delegated admin account 222222222222 enabled for servicecatalog.amazonaws.com).
eval_cases.expected_output:
PORTFOLIO: Data Products (products: 1, shares: ou-abc1-abcdef in us-east-1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + consumer scope: Distribute Aurora Reader Endpoint product to Data Platform OU, scope ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT
  [✓] Portfolio created: Data Products by Data Platform (us-east-1)
  [✓] Product(s): 1 product (Aurora Reader Endpoint), 1 provisioning artifact (v2.1.0 active)
  [✓] Product-portfolio association: 1 association
  [✓] Constraint(s): LAUNCH sc-launch-aurora-role (STACK-based, scoped to rds:*), TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED
  [✓] TagOptions: 1 key-value pair bound at portfolio level (CostCenter=data-9999)
  [✓] Share(s): ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT ou-abc1-abcdef (region: us-east-1, delegated admin: account 222222222222 enabled)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio --id port-cccc3333
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio-shares --portfolio-id port-cccc3333 --type ORGANIZATION
  aws organizations list-delegated-administrators --service-principal servicecatalog.amazonaws.com

eval_cases.name: Multi-region consumer requires region replication or documented expectation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — region mismatch documented, replication via StackSets recommended
eval_cases.prompt: Provision portfolio "Multi-Region S3" by "Platform Governance" in us-east-1 with the S3-bucket product and full constraints (LAUNCH sc-launch-s3-role, TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED). The consumer accounts are in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. TagOptions CostCenter=platform-1234. Share with ORGANIZATION o-abc123def456 (Organizations enabled). Multi-region rollout is required.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PORTFOLIO: Multi-Region S3 (products: 1, shares: o-abc123def456 in us-east-1; replication required for eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + consumer scope: Distribute S3-bucket product to multi-region consumers (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1), scope ORGANIZATION
  [✓] Portfolio created: Multi-Region S3 by Platform Governance (us-east-1)
  [✓] Product(s): 1 product (Curated S3 Bucket), 1 provisioning artifact (v1.0.0)
  [✓] Product-portfolio association: 1 association
  [✓] Constraint(s): LAUNCH sc-launch-s3-role (STACK-based), TAG_UPDATE NOT_ALLOWED
  [✓] TagOptions: 1 key-value pair bound at portfolio level (CostCenter=platform-1234)
  [✓] Share(s): ORGANIZATION o-abc123def456 (region: us-east-1, delegated admin: enabled) [WARN: consumers in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 will not see the portfolio unless replication in those regions is configured. Use CloudFormation StackSets to replicate the portfolio + product + share in each consumer region.]
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio --id port-dddd4444
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio-shares --portfolio-id port-dddd4444 --type ORGANIZATION
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name sc-portfolio-replication

eval_cases.name: Terraform Open Source Service Catalog product from Git
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — TERRAFORM_OPEN_SOURCE engine available, Git source URL
eval_cases.prompt: Build portfolio "Terraform Products" by "Platform Governance" in us-east-1. Product: "Terraform S3 Bucket" (TERRAFORM_OPEN_SOURCE) sourced from git::https://github.com/example/terraform-s3-bucket.git?ref=v1.0.0 (engine confirmed available in us-east-1). Version v1.0.0. Constraints: LAUNCH sc-launch-tf-s3-role (exists). TagOptions: Owner=platform-governance at portfolio level. Local account only.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PORTFOLIO: Terraform Products (products: 1, shares: local account only in us-east-1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + consumer scope: Distribute Terraform S3-bucket product to local-account users, scope local
  [✓] Portfolio created: Terraform Products by Platform Governance (us-east-1)
  [✓] Product(s): 1 product (Terraform S3 Bucket), 1 provisioning artifact (v1.0.0 active) [TERRAFORM_OPEN_SOURCE engine verified available in us-east-1]
  [✓] Product-portfolio association: 1 association
  [✓] Constraint(s): LAUNCH sc-launch-tf-s3-role (STACK-based)
  [✓] TagOptions: 1 key-value pair bound at portfolio level (Owner=platform-governance)
  [✓] Share(s): local account only (region: us-east-1)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws servicecatalog describe-portfolio --id port-eeee5555
  aws servicecatalog list-provisioning-engine-types --query 'ProvisioningEngineTypes'
  aws servicecatalog describe-product --id prod-ffff6666
